tracks.theme: Cool green escape at the peak of summer - the high meadows at Sonamarg and Pahalgam green and cool, snow still on the peaks, the valley wide open while the plains bake
tracks.subject: Snow on the peaks, green in the meadows

tracks.theme: Peak-week rides booking all day at the busiest time of year - airport pickups, valley drives to Pahalgam and Sonamarg, golden-hour shikaras; idle cabs and boats do not come back
tracks.subject: Peak-week airport runs are booking past your cab

tracks.theme: Peak Dal Lake demand - travellers booking every houseboat they can find; an unlisted boat loses the guest to a listed one. Karew Sa Join Kashrew
tracks.subject: The lake is full this week and your boat is unlisted
